name: athena
title: Athena
description: Capture to, search and tick things off in your own Athena.
author: matthojo

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Capture
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: Write something down. Athena files it as a to-do, a note, a date or a person's detail.

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: Send one line to Athena without opening a window.

commands.name: save-link
commands.title: Save Link
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: Save a link to Saved: the one you type, the selected one, the browser tab in front, or the one on the clipboard.

commands.name: save-selection
commands.title: Save Selection
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: Save the selected text to Saved as a quote, with the page it came from when a browser is in front.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Athena
commands.description: Find people, notes, to-dos, places, saved things and days. Needs a full access key.

commands.name: todos
commands.title: To-Dos
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: What's open, soonest first. Tick things off or move their date. Needs a full access key.

commands.name: add-todo
commands.title: Add To-Do
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: Add a to-do with a date, exactly as you type it. Needs a full access key.

commands.name: coming-up
commands.title: Coming up
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: Events, birthdays and deadlines in the next two weeks, and who's due a catch-up. Needs a full access key.

commands.name: habits
commands.title: Habits
commands.subtitle: Athena
commands.description: Tick today's habits. With a capture key, log one by name.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Athena Menu Bar
commands.description: What's due today and what's on, in the menu bar. Needs a full access key.

preferences.name: address
preferences.title: Athena Address
preferences.description: Where your Athena lives, for example https://athena.example.com.

preferences.name: key
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Made in Athena under Settings → API keys. A capture key (athc_…) can only add things. A full access key (athk_…) also lets Raycast search and read.
